name: Flat White
description: Double ristretto pulled over velvety whole-milk microfoam. Rich and concentrated — the way it should be.

name: Cortado
description: Equal parts espresso and warm milk. No foam

name: Oat Cappuccino
description: Single-origin espresso with thick oat-milk foam. Naturally sweet and creamy.

name: Long Black
description: Hot water poured over a double ristretto to preserve the crema. Clean and bold.

name: Honey Lavender Latte
description: Double espresso with house lavender syrup and a swirl of local honey. Floral and grounding.

name: Piccolo
description: A short milk coffee — ristretto in a 100ml glass with a touch of steamed milk.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coarsely ground Guatemalan beans steeped 18 hours in cold water. Smooth with no bitterness.

name: Iced Caramel Amber
description: Cold brew over ice with house caramel and a splash of oat milk. Sweet without being cloying.

name: Sparkling Cascara
description: Cascara — the dried coffee cherry husk — brewed and chilled with a hit of soda. Lightly tart and fizzy.

name: Still Lemonade
description: Hand-pressed lemons with cane sugar and a pinch of sea salt. Made fresh daily.

name: Almond Croissant
description: Twice-baked with house frangipane and a heavy hand with flaked almonds. Flaky and deeply buttery.

name: Pain au Chocolat
description: Dark 70% Valrhona chocolate tucked into laminated butter dough. Best warm.

name: Morning Bun
description: Orange zest and cinnamon sugar rolled into croissant dough and baked until caramelised at the edges.

name: Banana Bread
description: Dense and moist with ripe bananas
badge: and a crust of raw sugar. A thick slice — not a sliver.

name: Cardamom Knot
description: Enriched dough with brown butter and freshly ground cardamom. Twisted and glazed.

name: Prosciutto & Pecorino
description: Thinly sliced prosciutto
column6: and grainy mustard on toasted sourdough.

name: Roasted Mushroom & Gruyère
description: Slow-roasted mixed mushrooms with gruyère
badge: and crème fraîche on dark rye.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
description: House-cured salmon with cream cheese
column6: and dill on a sesame bagel.

name: BLT on Brioche
description: Streaky bacon
column6: and house aioli on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Egg & Aged Cheddar
description: Soft scrambled eggs with aged cheddar and chive butter on a seeded English muffin.
